items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new production work. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, including 18 named tracking rows plus an unattributed aggregate row. September AI usage is $950.44 from 5,316 calls across 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30. These periods and attribution scopes do not support revenue forecasts, ROI, payback, contribution margin, or cost-to-learn claims.

Financial disposition: retain existing period-aligned reconciliation only. Contribution margin is unknown because site/content-attributed revenue and matching-period allocated costs are unavailable. Budget exposure is unknown because monthly spend, fixed-cost, and marketing-budget fields are blank; infrastructure spend is not present in the snapshot. Cost-to-learn is unknown because incremental learning outcomes, attributable implementation cost, and an approved learning threshold are unavailable. Minimum evidence is a dated ledger matching revenue, AI, infrastructure, and implementation costs to the same site or content and period, plus a defined learning threshold.

Preserve Amazon revenue as aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21: $4.92 commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Do not allocate the 629-click aggregate row or its 28 orders, 6 shipments, and $4.92 commission to sites without provider-supported attribution. Continue the existing tracking-ID integrity reconciliation only; do not request duplicate telemetry or rewrite historical attribution.

Continue existing deployed-work measurement and finance reconciliation only. Do not use 54 measurement items, 21 failed requests, 7 open repairs, 10/10 active slots, or proposal volume as financial performance. Preserve unavailable revenue, cost, margin, ROI, payback, budget, and causal-lift fields as unknown.
